app.empty_no_supply: Bezy is brand new here — no one discoverable yet. Check back soon, and tell someone about Bezy.
app.empty_eligibility: No one nearby matches who you're looking for right now. You can update “I am” and “Looking for” in your profile, or check back later.

app.age_gate_title: Bezy is only available to people aged 18 and over.

app.error_age_required: Please confirm you are 18 or older to continue.
app.safety_intro: Block or report anyone who makes you uncomfortable.
app.data_controls_intro: Bezy keeps your data while processing is paused or objected to — nothing is deleted, and you can lift either at any time.
app.privacy_by_design: Messages stay between you and your match. Your photos stay on Telegram. We use your city, not your GPS.
app.safety_sheet_note: Blocking and reporting take effect immediately and are enforced by Bezy's servers.
app.block_confirm: {name} will no longer see you or be able to contact you through Bezy. Your match will be ended.
app.unmatch_confirm: End your match with {name}? Neither of you will see the other in Bezy again.
app.report_done: Report sent. This person has also been blocked.
app.report_note: Reporting also blocks this person. Bezy reviews reports; we cannot promise a response time.
app.delete_explain: This permanently deletes your Bezy profile, your likes and passes, your matches and your blocks. It cannot be undone.
app.delete_retained: Records of payments you made and their invoice links are kept for accounting, and reports — filed by you or about you — are kept for safety. Your Telegram account itself is not affected.
app.delete_done_title: Your Bezy account has been deleted.
app.delete_done_body: You can close this window. If you ever want to come back, just open Bezy again and create a new profile.
app.rights_note: For corrections or a complaint, contact contacts@digitalconcordia.com.
app.support_intro: Bezy support can help diagnose common problems.
app.support_formal: Need to make a formal privacy or legal request? Contact us.
app.support_form_placeholder: What happened? What have you tried?
app.support_required: Choose a topic and describe the problem.
app.support_done: Your support request has been received. Reference: {ref}. We'll review it and get back to you here.
app.support_expectation: We read every message and aim to answer within 3 working days.
app.rate_limited: You're going a little fast. Please try again in a moment.
app.rate_limited_minutes: You've done that too many times. Please try again in about {n} minutes.
app.stars_needed: You need Telegram Stars in your balance to subscribe. You can top up in Telegram under Settings, then My Stars.
app.not_telegram_premium: Telegram Premium is a separate Telegram subscription. It does not include Bezy Premium — Bezy Premium is paid separately with Stars.
app.premium_lapsed_hint: You can subscribe again below. Your profile, matches and conversations are unaffected.
app.prompts_hint: Optional. Answer up to three — they appear on your profile and give people something to open with.
app.prompt_should_know: One thing you should know about me…
app.prompt_talk_for_hours: Something I could talk about for hours…
app.preview_hint: This is your card as it appears in Discover. Your Telegram username stays hidden until you match.
app.preview_incomplete: Complete your profile to see how it will look.

app.starter_generic: Start with something simple about what you already have in common.

app.msg_premium_locked: Messaging is a Premium feature. Unlock Premium to chat with your matches.
app.notify_messages_note: When a match sends you a message
app.notifications_hint: Choose what Bezy sends you in Telegram. Payment and account messages are always sent, because they are a record of something that happened to your account.
app.notify_super_likes_note: Bezy never says who sent it — open Bezy and decide for yourself.
app.notify_profile_reminders_note: At most one a week, and only while your profile is incomplete.
app.restrict_explain: Bezy keeps your data but stops using it. Your profile leaves Discover, you cannot like or match, and Bezy stops sending you match and Super Like messages. Nothing is deleted, and you can lift this at any time.
app.restricted_notice: Bezy is storing your data and nothing else. Lift the pause to return to Discover.
app.restrict_done: Processing is paused. Your data is kept, not used.
app.unrestrict_done: Processing resumed. Turn on “Show my profile in Discover” when you are ready to be seen again.
app.restrict_note: This is the right to restriction of processing. Payment and account messages are still sent, and you can still download or delete your data.
app.error_processing_restricted: Processing is paused for your account. Resume it in Safety & privacy to continue.
app.objection_explain: You have the right to object to the way Bezy processes your data (GDPR Art. 21). If you object, Bezy stops using your data for discovery and matching: your profile leaves Discover, you cannot like or match, and Bezy stops sending you match and Super Like messages. Nothing is deleted, and you can withdraw the objection at any time.
app.objection_notice: Bezy is storing your data and nothing else. Withdraw the objection to return to Discover.
app.objection_done: Objection recorded. Bezy has stopped processing your data.
app.unobject_done: Objection withdrawn. Turn on “Show my profile in Discover” when you are ready to be seen again.
app.objection_note: This is the right to object to processing. Your data is kept, not deleted, and you can still download or delete your data.
app.languages_hint: Optional. Up to five. Used to show you people you can actually talk to.
app.filter_languages_hint: Leave empty to see everyone. Profiles that have not listed a language are always shown.
